title: Security
subtitle: Authentication surfaces and dashboard access for this Node-RED instance.
passwordNote: NRCC stores admin auth, Node HTTP auth and Static auth passwords as bcrypt hashes and keeps a value that is already hashed as is. Leave a password blank to keep the stored one.

applyErrors.revisionConflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Refresh, review the redacted preview, then retry.
applyErrors.inFlight: Another transaction is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
applyErrors.validationFailed: The configuration did not validate. Review the fields and retry.
applyErrors.revisionMissing: The settings revision is unavailable. Refresh before retrying.
applyErrors.generic: The transaction did not complete. Any failed readiness check is rolled back; review runtime readiness, then retry.
